title.zh: 响应式页眉与页脚间距调整

purpose.en: Keep the shared mobile menu control visually distinct and give the global footer balanced spacing on phone and desktop layouts.
purpose.zh: 让共享移动菜单按钮保持清晰可辨，并在手机与桌面布局中提供均衡的全局页脚间距。

en: Give the hamburger control a visible border, light surface and readable foreground color.
Normalize footer section, identity and navigation gaps across responsive breakpoints.
Reserve footer navigation space for the fixed AI assistant control.
zh: 为汉堡菜单按钮提供清晰边框、浅色背景及易读前景色。
统一不同响应式断点下的页脚区域、品牌标识及导航间距。
为固定显示的 AI 助手按钮预留页脚导航空间。

en: Shared site header menu control and global footer layout.
zh: 影响共享站点页眉菜单控件及全局页脚布局。

en: Apply the existing shared-shell spacing rules and prevent the floating assistant from covering the final footer link without changing navigation destinations, copy, branding, authentication or commerce behavior.
zh: 应用现有共享外壳间距规则，并防止浮动助手遮挡最后一个页脚链接；不修改导航目的地、文案、品牌、身份验证或商业功能。

en: Run the repository validation workflow and verify the production header and footer at phone and desktop widths in Chinese and English.
zh: 运行仓库验证工作流，并以中文和英文在手机及桌面宽度检查生产页眉与页脚。

en: No product, data, payment, identity, provider or infrastructure behavior changes.
zh: 不修改产品、数据、付款、身份、供应商或基础设施行为。

en: Preserve greatlovemeta.com branding, typography, navigation and site-owned infrastructure.
zh: 保留 greatlovemeta.com 的品牌、字体、导航及站点独立基础设施。

rollback.en: Restore the preceding application release; no data migration is required.
rollback.zh: 恢复上一应用版本即可；无需数据迁移。
